content:
katie: quick note — prototyping a compact 'snapshot' tile that sits above the timeline when a canary deploy is active. goal: reduce vertical clutter but keep status + rollback affordance. sam: love the density idea. question: how do we announce new snapshots to screen readers? currently timeline updates are silent. ben: +1. also worried about the tap target for rollback in compact mode — could be small on mobile. maya: UX question: if we compress tile, does the microcopy need to change? 'View' vs 'Open snapshot'? design-bot: new image uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/snap-compact-v2.png katie: proposed microcopy: 'Canary snapshot — 5% traffic · 2m ago. View • Rollback' — thoughts? sam: prefer 'Open snapshot' over 'View' for clarity. accessibility: aria-live='polite' on the tile container when new snapshot created, and add role='button' with aria-label='Open canary snapshot, 5 percent allocation'. ben: for rollback action we should require a confirmation modal and make the button primary danger. mobile: increase hit area to 44px. maya: nit: contrast of 'Rollback' pill is 3.8:1 — need 4.5:1 for small text. can we darken it 8%? katie: agreed. also request: add keyboard focus ring visible in compact state. and add a tooltip on hover 'Snapshot includes route, model version, and rollout rule'. sam: small code suggestion: ```html
``` ben: looks good. one more: screen reader should announce 'New canary snapshot created for service X — press Open snapshot to inspect' — add sr-only text inserted on creation. maya: leaving this for design pass + a11y review. @sam can you follow up with copy team tomorrow? :wave: sam: yep, I'll ping copy and a11y. moving to mock updates. katie: thanks. marking as design review done for now :thumbsup:
